title: Claude Code or Codex?
description:
Five hundred developers got surveyed. Day-to-day preference goes to Codex — autonomous, fast, less hand-holding. But when the same devs blind-reviewed the actual code? Claude won. Asks more questions. Produces tighter output. "Which is better" was always the wrong frame. Different tools, different jobs. Smart builders don't choose. They route.

#claude #codex #openai #anthropic #aitools #shorts
